resources.string: Check storage, interrupted moves, trash and save copies here. Every recovery needs your confirmation.
Existing files are preserved when they differ from the recovery copy. Move cleanup removes originals only after their destination is verified.
The current save is copied and verified before this version is restored. Cloud synchronization needs a fresh comparison afterwards.
Some folders could not be checked, or the scan limit was reached. Open the specific folder in Files to check further.
Storage is back. Transfers stay paused until you resume them.
Folder access was lost. Select the folder again in Settings.
Storage is unavailable. Reconnect it and check again.
The last listing is kept. Reconnect the storage and check again before changing files.
